date_note: The Northern Miner (23 Nov) gives the attack as Friday 20 November and the CEO's remarks as made at Monday's annual meeting; 23 November is the day the company's statement was reported.
exec: Peninsula Energy says operations at its Lance uranium project are suspended after its plant and wellfield operating and control systems were impacted; it says corporate and administrative systems remain unaffected, per SecurityWeek.
geo_basis: state named in the source; map pin at the centre of Wyoming
plain: Peninsula Energy says plant and wellfield operating and control systems at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming were impacted on 20 November, and that operations are suspended until recovery and verification are complete, per SecurityWeek.
summary: The Northern Miner reports a cyberattack on Friday, 20 November hit the operating server and system at Peninsula Energy's Lance uranium project in Wyoming. SecurityWeek reports the company said in a 25 November update that plant and wellfield operating and control systems at Lance were impacted on 20 November and that operations are suspended until recovery and verification are complete. The company said corporate and administrative systems remain unaffected.
title: Peninsula Energy says cyberattack hit operating server at Lance uranium project in Wyoming

validation.note: The Northern Miner (CEO remarks at the annual meeting) and Cowboy State Daily (company statement, trading halt request) are independent publishers that both state the attack on the Lance operating system; the company's ASX announcement was not read.

review.note: title, date, operating-system scope, trading halt, corroboration vs Northern Miner and Cowboy State Daily
